span.p:
The rejected review remains immutable.
A new deliverable and new reviews carry lineage.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Blocked is not rejection and does not
automatically enter the rework cascade.
Explicit intervention must create the next valid step.
